name: Organization of Turkic States (2012–2024)
description: A light-blue field charged at the centre with a white emblem combining a radiant sun, an eight-pointed star and a crescent.
history: Adopted at the Turkic Council's second summit in Bishkek on 23 August 2012 and first raised on 12 October 2012. At the eleventh summit, again in Bishkek, on 6 November 2024 the organisation presented a revised flag with straightened sun rays following Kyrgyzstan's 2023 flag change and an added Seljuk star.

features.symbolism: the blue of the Kazakh flag
